newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian wedding bus falls into river, killing 29.
newsitem.headline: Indian wedding bus falls into river, killing 29.

text.p: Twenty-nine people in a wedding party were killed when a minibus plunged off a road and sank in a rain-swollen river in the northern Indian state of Punjab on Sunday, police said.
The bus, carrying at least 50 people, some perched on the roof, went out of control at a sharp bend on a state highway in Kapurthala district, some 350 km (220 miles) northwest of New Delhi.
A Punjab police official said 27 people died on the spot and two later in a hospital. A dozen injured were admitted to a local hospital.
An estimated 50,000 people die in road accidents each year in India.
